description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the values associated with different data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and has a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with no unit specified, and tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue line, representing "Tutorials", begins at approximately 22 at 200 tokens, decreases to approximately 27 at 600 tokens, and then increases to approximately 31 at 1000 tokens. A red line, representing "Library Documentation", starts at approximately 27 at 200 tokens, increases to approximately 32 at 600 tokens, and then decreases to approximately 29 at 1000 tokens. A yellow line, representing "StackOverflow posts", begins at approximately 31 at 200 tokens, and decreases to approximately 11 at 1000 tokens. A green line, representing "Github files", starts at approximately 30 at 200 tokens, increases to approximately 33 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to approximately 31 at 1000 tokens.
